program_alignment.central_question: Are R6I mini-bucket marginal errors and cancellations stable across the existing exact primitive observation/prior cohort?
program_alignment.epistemic_role: prerequisite validation before selecting GBP or tensor approximation
program_alignment.downstream_gate: do not select an approximation family or run correction/LER until accuracy is tested across matched exact observations

research_basis.method_source: Dechter and Rish, Mini-buckets: A general scheme for bounded inference, JACM 50 (2003), DOI 10.1145/636865.636866
research_basis.partition_sensitivity_source: Rollon and Dechter, New Mini-Bucket Partitioning Heuristics for Bounding the Probability of Evidence, AAAI 2010
research_basis.project_source: R6I showed exact ceilings but one-observation cancellation and nonmonotone marginal error

question.H1: the R6I auxiliary-first exact pseudo-marginal cancellation is not robust across all observation strata and both priors
question.H2: increasing i-bound tightens evidence bounds in every matched branch but does not guarantee monotone marginal-error improvement in every condition
question.H3: no single representation/order branch achieves max marginal error <=1e-2 on every condition at i<=14
question.falsification: any evidence-bound violation or exact-ceiling mismatch above 1e-10 rejects the implementation or cohort

matrix.prospective_cancellation: evidence ratio >2 and max marginal error <1e-10
matrix.budget: under ten CPU minutes and 2 GiB; deterministic exact-reference computation only

analysis.unit: one observation × p × representation × order × i row
analysis.aggregation: report worst, median, useful-accuracy coverage, cancellation count, monotonicity violations, and condition-wise best branches without post-hoc branch deletion
analysis.stop_rule: report the complete matrix; use its failure pattern to register the next approximation prerequisite, not correction or LER sampling
analysis.claim_boundary: Primitive deterministic validation only; no paper-L2 accuracy, scalable decoder, correction, LER, threshold, runtime-scaling, or fault-tolerance claim.

acceptance_items.item: complete 128-row exact-reference matrix and invariant checks
acceptance_items.evidence: results/r6j-multi-observation-mini-bucket-validation.json; all rows complete and 56 exact-ceiling rows pass

acceptance_items.item: analysis of cancellation, monotonicity, and useful-accuracy coverage
acceptance_items.evidence: 20/32 auxiliary low-i cancellations, 3 evidence and 14 marginal monotonicity violations, 0 uniformly useful low-i branches

acceptance_items.item: report, roadmap, metadata, and durable state

hypothesis_outcomes.H1: supported: auxiliary-first low-i cancellation occurs in 20/32 rows, not all matched conditions
hypothesis_outcomes.H2: rejected as written: evidence ratios are nonmonotone in 3/32 sequences and marginal errors in 14/32; the greedy partitions are not nested as i changes
hypothesis_outcomes.H3: supported: zero representation/order branches achieve max marginal error <=1e-2 on all eight conditions at i<=14
